pages.title: Xenobiology
pages.text: $(thing)Xenobiology$()$(br2)Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

$(thing)Insight$(): 130$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Synthetic Biology, Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 16 Genome Sample.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): An alien genome is a string of L letters drawn from an alphabet of b chemically distinct bases, base j appearing with probability p_j. Write the information it can store, in bits: the length times the average surprise per letter, built from the probabilities and their logarithms, converted from natural units to bits.
